They can communicate with patients by mobile phone and can leave for food or 'fresh air' etc. - there are food facilities , toilets etc  by the main reception area as you enter the Treatment Centre .

Do be aware that parking is very limited directly in front of the Treatment Centre but there is a large 'Drop off' parking area with benches for people to wait ( but it is open to the elements ! ) A 'pay as you leave' scheme operates throughout the hospital and a ticket machine is in the foyer of the Treatment Centre .
